strapiBlog.title: After Jeddah, A New Trump Tower and Hotel is Coming to Dubai!
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai’s skyline is about to get even more iconic! Dar Global, a leading international luxury real estate developer, has announced a major collaboration with The Trump Organization to launch the prestigious Trump Tower Dubai.

data.text:
Dubai’s skyline is about to get even more iconic! Dar Global, a leading international luxury real estate developer, has announced a major collaboration with The Trump Organization to launch the prestigious Trump Tower Dubai. In fact, this will be the company’s first tower project to launch after Donald Trump assumed office on January 20 as U.S. President.

While the exact location and design details are yet to be revealed, the announcement has already sparked immense interest among luxury real estate investors and enthusiasts. Let’s tell you what we know so far about the highly-anticipated project.

What to Expect from Trump Tower Dubai?

The AED 2 billion-plus Trump Tower is set to debut in 2025. This architectural marvel will feature:

  • Trump Hotel – Offering world-class hospitality, opulent interiors, and signature Trump service.
  • Branded Residences – Luxurious branded residences with premium finishes and breathtaking city views.
  • The Trump Private – An elite, members-only club for VIPs seeking exclusivity and unmatched privileges.

With its unparalleled amenities and grand design, Trump Tower Dubai is expected to become one of the city’s most sought-after addresses.

data.text:
Trump’s Second Big Project in the UAE

This isn’t the first time the Trump brand has made its mark in Dubai. The Trump Estates at DAMAC Hills already stands as a luxury residential destination. However, Trump Tower Dubai will be the first standalone skyscraper carrying the Trump name in the emirate.

Interestingly, a Trump Tower was first proposed in Dubai in 2005 as Palm Trump International Hotel & Tower, planned for Palm Jumeirah. However, the project was suspended indefinitely in 2009 due to financial challenges. With this new partnership between Dar Global and The Trump Organization, Trump Tower Dubai is now a reality, with more details expected by the end of 2024.

Trump Organization Expands Its Footprint in the Region

The Trump Organization is rapidly expanding its global presence. Speaking about the project, Eric Trump, Executive Vice President of The Trump Organization, stated:

“We are proud to expand our presence in the region further through the launch of our iconic Trump Tower Dubai in collaboration with the world-class luxury developer Dar Global. It exemplifies our commitment to excellence and luxury, and we look forward to bringing our vision to life in one of the world’s most dynamic cities.”

This new venture follows Trump International Oman, a $500 million luxury development launched in partnership with Dar Global, and the upcoming Trump Tower Jeddah in Saudi Arabia.

A Game-Changer for Dubai’s Luxury Market

Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, highlighted the impact of Trump Tower Dubai, stating:

“This unique luxury project will enhance our track record of creating bespoke landmark properties in the region and contribute to elevating Dubai’s skyline while highlighting the city’s reputation as a worldwide beacon of excellence and sophistication.”

With its commitment to architectural excellence and world-class luxury, Dar Global is set to redefine high-end real estate in Dubai, and Trump Tower Dubai will be at the heart of this transformation.

Stay tuned for more updates on Trump Tower Dubai!

faqs.question: When will Trump Tower Dubai be completed?

data.answer: While the exact timeline is yet to be confirmed, Trump Tower Dubai is expected to launch in 2025, with more details on its location and design to be revealed by the end of 2024.

Besides Trump Tower Dubai, Trump Towers can be found in several countries around the world, including:

  • United States – Multiple Trump Towers are located in cities such as New York, Chicago, Las Vegas, and Sunny Isles Beach, Florida.
  • Canada – Trump International Hotel and Tower in Toronto, which has since been rebranded.
  • Turkey – Trump Towers Istanbul, featuring a mix of residential and commercial spaces.
  • Philippines – Trump Tower Manila, a luxury residential skyscraper.
  • India – Trump Towers in Mumbai, Pune, and Kolkata, developed under licensing agreements.
  • Kazakhstan – A planned Trump Tower in Astana, though its status remains uncertain.

faqs.question: When is Trump Tower Jeddah expected to be completed?

data.answer: Trump Tower Jeddah is set for completion by December 2029. The 47-story development will include luxury residences and introduce the Kingdom’s first members-only Trump Club.
The Trump Organization is a multinational business conglomerate owned by Donald Trump. It has interests in real estate, hospitality, and golf courses worldwide.
